page_title: LEG 0-1 BAR | Leganes v Barcelona 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' Pedri (Barcelona) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his low drive towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
90+2' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

90+1' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Leganes.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
87' Dani Raba (Leganes) is penalised.
86' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

86' Pedri (Barcelona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
85' Wonderful movement by Leganes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
83' Raphinha (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
81' Raphinha (Barcelona) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
81' Raphinha (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
80' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) replacing Eric Garcia.
79' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

77' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets to a rebound inside the penalty area, controls it with a nice touch and shoots towards the left post. However, the excellent Marko Dmitrovic makes a save and thwarts the great opportunity.

76' Diego Garcia (Leganes) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
75' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Seydouba Cisse will be replaced by Munir El Haddadi (Leganes).
75' Here comes a substitution. Diego Garcia (Leganes) is brought on as a substitute for Adria Altimira.

74' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Barcelona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
72' The attendance is 12530.
71' A goal, which was scored by Dani Raba (Leganes), was disallowed due to offside.

69' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Marko Dmitrovic makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom right corner.
68' Adria Altimira (Leganes) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
67' Robert Lewandowski comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
67' Here is a change. Fermin Lopez is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Gavi (Barcelona).
67' A substitution has been made. Oscar Rodriguez goes off and Yvan Neyou (Leganes) comes on.
66' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Valentin Rosier (Leganes) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. Leganes will have a throw-in.
65' Barcelona keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
64' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
62' None of the Leganes players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
59' Borja Jimenez has decided to make a change. Juan Cruz (Leganes) replaces Yan Diomande.

59' Leganes slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

58' The opposition can't get near Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
56' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
54' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Gerard Martin (Barcelona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
53' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
50' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
48' 0 - 1 Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) puts the ball past his own goalkeeper.
46' Hansi Flick makes a switch. Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is coming on in place of Ronald Araujo at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.

43' Dani Raba (Leganes) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
41' The corner is swung in but Leganes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' A substitution has been made. Alejandro Balde is replaced by Gerard Martin (Barcelona).
40' Yan Diomande (Leganes) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Leganes force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Dani Raba (Leganes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
37' Wonderful movement by Barcelona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' Marko Dmitrovic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

31' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
31' Barcelona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
29' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul. Barcelona have a free kick.
27' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
27' The corner from Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is cleared away by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.

27' Pedri (Barcelona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' Leganes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

22' Marko Dmitrovic makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Jules Kounde (Barcelona) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the right side of the target. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
20' Yan Diomande (Leganes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
19' Dani Raba (Leganes) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
17' The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
13' Great chance! Adria Altimira (Leganes) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
10' Barcelona showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is out of play. Leganes will take a throw-in.
7' Adria Altimira (Leganes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
6' Leganes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' Yan Diomande (Leganes) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Leganes manage to earn a corner.
5' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
4' Dangerous play by Seydouba Cisse (Leganes). Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Barcelona have a free kick from a promising distance.
4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Barcelona will have a corner.
2' Barcelona take a short corner kick.

2' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.
